decision.basis: Controls establish the recorder capability. Existing representative failures have no event CPU witnesses, and the current reader/writer are fixture-specific; they cannot validate a real route.
decision.inconclusive_policy: Stop and choose an explicit bounded implementation/policy decision; do not add another observer family automatically.
decision.next_task: Implement a bounded one-shot operation-witness controller and saved route reader, with finite stop/write-failure controls and a matching portable candidate; leave its launch request disabled.
decision.observation_preconditions: Prospective exact-candidate/workload declaration and verified failure/overflow/counter/I/O stopping, finite caps and no retry.
decision.preparation_owner_expansion: deferred; no new causal owner established

consumed_prefix_failure.qualification: Complete failed measurement retained; no cause or operation pass inferred.
